svg.title: Plasma channel length and total weapon envelope
svg.desc: A production ion cannon beside short, medium and long two-colour top-down weapon schematics at all five expected zooms. The channel stays 0.8 world units wide and the light core stays 1 unit wide. Channel lengths are 4.1, 6.15 and 8.2 units. An identical receiver and nose allowance make total lengths 10.1, 12.15 and 14.2 units. No detailed weapon art or side ports are selected.
svg.text: Selected widths: channel 0.8 u / core 1 u · fixed supporting body 3.8 u wide · total length = channel + 6 u
Two-colour overhead schematics · light painted above World via native hard-light · same falloff and fractional end fade
Expected Planet Inspector zooms · native sheet width 1056 CSS px · no selected length, detailed weapon art or side ports
